scope: Independent known TCP-denial validation source feasibility; not final scoring or detector fitting.
publisher_portal_observation: Server error; no personal form submitted. Use a declared public mirror, not a claim of publisher-authenticated bytes.
development_V_group: Entire 03-11 capture source; no portion becomes an untouched final set.
reserved_final_K_candidate: Entire 01-12 source including all raw/context/labels; metadata listing only, no payload acquisition, opening or scoring before freeze.
label_member_rule: Read only the unique Syn.csv member from the 03-11 ZIP; inventory directory names first. Do not open other CSV payloads.
selection_before_features: Inventory Syn labels and packet metadata at these publisher web-server HTTP(S) endpoints. Prefer greatest corroborated nonempty SYN coverage, tie by service string; no model scores. No silent aggregation across all destination ports.
time_policy: Treat folder/day names as source identifiers; establish actual PCAP/CSV UTC alignment from evidence rather than trusting date/schedule strings.
stream_policy: ZIP members may be rotations of one capture, not independent sessions. Inventory times and order first; preserve whole 03-11 ownership by V, reset only at documented stream/session boundaries, not arbitrary filenames.
label_policy: Corroborate canonical directional counts and compatible SYN evidence. Uncertain/idle/unlabelled time is unknown. Filename/class prevalence does not automatically label every packet/second.
feature_policy: No fitted features, model scoring or training during feasibility. Declare selected raw stream, service and any gaps/guards in a new manifest before fresh causal extraction.
disk_policy: Download two pinned archives only; read members as streams, do not expand entire ZIPs. Preserve >=10 GiB free and bound requests/ranges.
excluded: all 01-12 payloads reserved as final K candidate
